dedupe_keys.name: 防災情報 地図情報とよなか fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 防災情報(地図情報とよなか) [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊中市. 大阪府豊中市の防災情報（地図情報とよなか)に関するオープンデータを掲載しています。 問い合わせ先 コミュニティ防災資機材庫場所について…都市経営部 危機管理課 消防署・出張所、消防団（機械器具置場）について…消防局 消防指令センター. Coverage: 豊中市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊中市. Its tags are 消防団, 消防署, 防災, 防災資機材庫. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-02-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
